Free calculators for employees in the Gulf

Every calculator follows the published law, shows each step, and cites the article or official source behind every figure. Free, with no sign-up.

United Arab Emirates

UAEUAE Gratuity Calculator21 then 30 days of basic salary per year, pro-rated, capped at two years' pay. UAEUAE Final Settlement CalculatorGratuity, unused leave, notice pay and unpaid salary in one figure.

Saudi Arabia

Saudi ArabiaEnd of Service CalculatorHalf a month then a full month per year, with the resignation fractions of Article 85. Saudi ArabiaDependent Fee and Iqama RenewalSAR 400 per dependent per month for 3, 6, 9 or 12 months, plus the employer's levy and iqama fees. Saudi ArabiaExit Re-entry Visa FeeSingle and multiple visas, and extensions from inside or outside the Kingdom.

Qatar

QatarQatar End of Service GratuityAt least 21 days of basic pay per year after one year, with no cap.

Kuwait

KuwaitKuwait Indemnity Calculator15 days then a month per year on the full wage, capped at 18 months.

Oman and Bahrain

OmanOman End of Service GratuityA month's basic pay per year since July 2023; earlier service under the old rule. BahrainBahrain End of Service GratuityHalf a month then a month per year, split between the employer and SIO.

Our full collection of over 70 calculators — annual and sick leave, maternity leave, notice pay, overtime, pensions, mortgages and end of service in all six Gulf countries — is in Arabic at mustahaqati.org. Your browser can translate those pages, and the calculations work the same way.

About Mustahaqati

Mustahaqati ("my entitlements") builds free calculators for employees' rights in the Gulf. We read the labour laws, executive regulations and official guidance of each country, turn every rule into a tested formula, and list our sources on each page with the date we last reviewed it. When a law changes, we update the calculators and note it in our law updates log (Arabic).

Our calculators are guidance tools, not legal advice. Contact us at info@mustahaqati.org.

Disclaimer: These calculators are guidance tools based on the published legal texts. They are not legal or financial advice. Your final amount may differ depending on your contract, your employment record and how the authorities apply the law. Always confirm with the official authority before making a decision.
